notes.note: Reviewed the StartComposer device-state change: it reads the same useDockSlotDevice coarsePointer used by reply input and exposes that capability to its own CSS. The visible touch focus indicator remains the box focus-within border; fine-pointer keyboard outline and textarea resizing are unchanged. The focus-outline inventory now explicitly records the replacement indicator with browser evidence. File intake, first-send staging, dictation ownership and Android IME limits are unchanged. No new page-local responsive at-rule or mobile baseline exemption was added.
